content.title: Spinnova buys Woodspin, Suzano Finland for €2, terminates JV
content.summary: Finnish material innovation company Spinnova has executed binding agreements to purchase all shares of Woodspin and Suzano Finland for €2 ($2.32), as well as securing exclusive rights on wood-based fibre.

thumbnail.caption: The agreement provides the rights to licence the Spinnova fibre technology. Credit: T. Schneider/Shutterstock.com.
